encoding_notes: Encoded from the live Instructions to Authors at https://jocr.co.in/wp/authors-guidelines/ fetched 2026-07-09 via clean curl (server-side-rendered HTML, 31258 normalized chars); source_hash reproducible.
Published by Indian Orthopaedic Research Group; open access under CC BY-NC 4.0. pISSN 2250-0685 / eISSN 2321-3817 (schema issn holds both).

Article-type mapping: case_report is the primary type (<=2000 words, abstract <=350 words, 10-30 refs). JOCR treats a case_series (5-10 cases) as a 'research article', so case_series and original_research both take original-article limits (<=3000 words, abstract <=400 words, up to 50 refs). review = review article / Blue Ribbon Reviews (<=3500 words, up to 50 refs). technical_note (surgical technique / technical note on a single case) is accepted but the guide gives no type-specific word limits or section list, so it is declared in article_types only.

abstract.sections reflect the primary case_report structure (Introduction / Case Presentation / Conclusion, <=350 words, min 3 keywords). Research/original/review articles instead use a 4-part abstract (Aim & Background / Materials & Methods / Result / Conclusion, <=400 words) — captured in the per-type section lists (Introduction/Methods/Results) but not in the single abstract.sections field.

'Learning Point of the Article' (one-line) and 'Clinical Message' are JOCR-specific mandatory manuscript elements; encoded as required sections. Consent is a compulsory section; Competing Interests and Authors' Contributions are required declarations placed inline in the manuscript per the guide.

figure/table counts: the guide is internally inconsistent — it states 'maximum 10 figures and tables' and 'JOCR can only publish ten figures' (top) but 'no more than 6 figures (and tables) per case report' (figure-legends subsection). Encoded figures_max=10 (the repeated primary limit); tables_max left null because the guide lumps 'figures and tables' into one combined cap rather than a separate table count.

references: Vancouver-style, numbered consecutively in SQUARE BRACKETS in citation order, NLM journal abbreviations (e.g., 'J Bone Joint Surg Am'); guide shows no DOI in reference examples, so include_doi=false. in_text_punctuation and et_al_threshold not stated -> null.

layout: alignment 'left' (guide: type text unjustified); line numbering required (encoded continuous); all pages numbered; double-line spacing per the JOCR 'Typography' section. NOTE the boilerplate submission checklist contradictorily says 'text is single-spaced; 12-point font' — the JOCR-authored Typography section (double-line spacing) was preferred; the 12-pt size was taken from the checklist. Font FAMILY is not specified by the guide (Times New Roman is a service default for the schema-required field).
title_case 'sentence' is explicit (guide: 'capitalize only the first word, and proper nouns, in the title'). Title should also embed the study design (e.g., '... : a case report').

Schema-forced/unstated fields flagged for author: page_size, margins_mm, first_line_indent, title length caps, running-title cap, min_dpi, keyword max, references max_count, layout.headings all null; orcid_required=false and running_head.show=false (not mentioned); blinding.scrub_metadata=true inferred from the required blinded-manuscript / 'ensuring a blind review' step.
CARE checklist / copyright form / author photos are submission-portal supplementary items, not manuscript formatting, and are tracked out-of-schema.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.
